passage.text: Songkran is the Thai New Year festival, and it's from April 13th to April 15th.
passage.reading: ˈsɔːŋkrɑːn ɪz ðə ˈtaɪ ˈnuː ˈjɪr ˈfɛstɪvəl, ənd ɪts frəm ˈeɪprəl ˌθɜːrˈtiːnθ tu ˈeɪprəl ˌfɪfˈtiːnθ.

passage.text: A lot of people think Chiang Mai has the best Songkran in Thailand.
passage.reading: ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈpiːpəl ˈθɪŋk ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ˈhæz ðə ˈbɛst ˈsɔːŋkrɑːn ɪn ˈtaɪlænd.

passage.text: On the first day, there's a big parade in the old city.
passage.reading: ɑːn ðə ˌfɜːrst ˈdeɪ, ðɛrz ə ˈbɪɡ pəˈreɪd ɪn ði ˈoʊld ˈsɪti.

passage.text: People in traditional clothes walk and dance in the street.
passage.reading: ˈpiːpəl ɪn trəˈdɪʃənəl ˈkloʊðz ˈwɔːk ənd ˈdæns ɪn ðə ˈstriːt.

passage.text: Then people throw water at their friends.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ˈpiːpəl ˈθroʊ ˈwɔːtər ət ðɛr ˈfrɛndz.

passage.text: Songkran is a lot of fun, but please show respect.
passage.reading: ˈsɔːŋkrɑːn ɪz ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈfʌn, bʌt ˈpliːz ˈʃoʊ rɪˈspɛkt.

passage.text: Don't throw water at monks or old people.
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈθroʊ ˈwɔːtər ət ˈmʌŋks ɔːr ˈoʊld ˈpiːpəl.

passage.text: And never throw water at people on motorcycles!
passage.reading: ənd ˈnɛvər ˈθroʊ ˈwɔːtər ət ˈpiːpəl ɑːn ˈmoʊtərsaɪkəlz!

passage.text: Many families go to the temple to make merit, too.
passage.reading: ˈmɛni ˈfæməliz ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈtɛmpəl tə ˌmeɪk ˈmɛrɪt, ˈtuː.
